name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's career began far from the roar of engines, in the disciplined ranks of the Russian military police. After years of service ensuring order and security in high-pressure environments, Dimitri transitioned his expertise to the world of motorsport. He saw in the paddock a unique challenge: protecting valuable assets and personnel in a fast-paced, ever-changing landscape.

He approaches security with a military precision, emphasizing meticulous planning and preventative measures. He's not just about reacting to threats; he believes in anticipating them, identifying vulnerabilities before they can be exploited. His loyalty is unwavering, and he demands the same dedication from his team. Dimitri's detail-oriented nature and ability to work independently make him a formidable asset, but his preference for solitary work can sometimes make collaboration a challenge.

What sets Dimitri apart is his understanding of the human element. He knows that technology is only as good as the people behind it, and he's adept at assessing individuals and identifying potential weaknesses or risks. He's a firm believer in proactive security, always seeking innovative ways to improve safety and prevent incidents before they occur.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A powerfully built man with a stern, observant gaze.

quirks: Insists on using military time, even in casual conversation.
Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with detailed notes and observations.
Has a habit of silently observing people, making them feel slightly unnerved.
